verdict.rationale: The docs are agent-oriented and confirmed by probes: llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and an official MCP server is documented. They show text-prompt video creation, webhooks for job notification, and an endpoint that returns the user's credit balance, so an agent can submit and watch a job and infer spend from the balance. However, the pack never shows a status-polling or asset-download endpoint, and cost is only a balance lookup rather than a per-job cost report. The claimed typed schemas are also not exposed as a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404). Missing for 10: documented job-status/poll endpoint, documented asset fetch/download URL retrieval, per-job cost reporting, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the loop.
